test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph given below shows production of truck by two companies L and M in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e56463561674bf376fd74448f1acb5742fd0f22d9732366cafd9bcc36e14d5ef.png] 

Which of the following statement is NOT correct?

I. The production of truck by company L in year Y1 is 24 percent of the production of company M in year Y1.

II. The ratio of production of truck by company L in year Y4 to the production of truck by company M in year Y4 are 10 : 3.

III. The average production of truck by company L in year Y2 and Y3 are 30.
solution:
**Calculation:**

The production of truck by company L in year Y1 = 60

The production of company M in year Y1 = 25

Percentage of the production of truck by company L in year Y1 to the production of company M in year Y1 = 60/25 × 100 = 240%

Statement I is not correct.

The production of truck by company L in year Y4 = 15

The production of truck by company M in year Y4 = 50

Ratio = 15 : 50 = 3 : 10
